propositions: Pandoc subprocess calls can hang indefinitely when processing pathological input (13.5 min observed) because pypandoc sets no timeout and subprocess.run(timeout=) reaps only the direct child, not pipe-holding grandchildren.

The timeout must be configurable (reconciler.dc_pandoc_timeout_s, default 10s) and enforced via caller-side proc.communicate(timeout=...) with process-group reaping via rebar._proc.reap_process_group on TimeoutExpired.

On timeout or non-zero exit, affected units degrade to original Markdown verbatim without raising; per-unit fallback semantics are unchanged and rendered output is byte-identical to the landed renderer.

The pandoc binary is delivered via pypandoc-binary==1.15 wheel (pinned in pyproject.toml) and its GPL-2.0-or-later license must be recorded in a new repo-root NOTICE file with version 3.6.1 and upstream metadata.
The timeout config key must be accessible from file and environment (REBAR_RECONCILER_DC_PANDOC_TIMEOUT_S) and documented in config.md; CI must verify the wheel pin is locked to exactly one version.
